name: cc-toolkit
description: Claude Code plugins for spec-driven delivery, code review, manual app testing, CI and pull-request chores, walkthrough videos as pull-request proof, plan review with OpenAI Codex, research reports, code stories, AI-slop cleanup for prose, hook rules, and a sound when Claude waits for you

plugins.name: codex-plan-improver
plugins.description: When you leave plan mode, sends Claude's plan to OpenAI Codex and revises it until Codex approves, for up to 5 rounds.

plugins.name: hookify
plugins.description: Stops Claude from repeating a mistake. Describe the behavior and it writes a hook rule that blocks or warns when it happens again.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Reviews a branch or pull request for correctness, security, naming, docs and more in parallel, and merges the findings into one report per file. Changes nothing until you pick the fixes to apply.

plugins.name: researcher
plugins.description: Answers a research question with an HTML report in which every claim links to a numbered source. Follow-up questions extend the same report.

plugins.name: tester
plugins.description: Tests your running app's API, UI and failure handling with checks drawn from a spec or your git diff. Returns a pass/fail table with evidence for each check.

plugins.name: fd3
plugins.description: Turns a rough idea into working code: settles the design with you, writes and checks a spec, and splits it into tasks. Then implements the tasks in parallel git worktrees and validates the result.

plugins.name: dev-kit
plugins.description: Fixes failed CI runs, keeps fixing a pull request until CI is green and review is resolved, and checks dependency upgrades against your code. Also opens pull requests labelled with how risky the change is, and merges the base branch into your branch and resolves the conflicts.

plugins.name: pr-proof
plugins.description: Records proof that a pull request's change works: a narrated video of the feature in your running app, screenshots or terminal transcripts. Picks the proof the change needs and attaches it to the pull request once you accept it.

plugins.name: stop-sound
plugins.description: Chimes when Claude waits for you: when it finishes a turn and when it asks a question. Silent while subagents work.

plugins.name: code-story
plugins.description: Explains a branch or pull request as a chaptered page for someone who has never seen the code, with notes pinned to the lines they explain. Publishes it as a private claude.ai page and updates it under the same link.

plugins.name: anti-slop
plugins.description: Rewrites AI-sounding English or Polish prose so it reads plain and human, keeping every fact, number and caveat.

plugins.name: collegium
plugins.description: Hands a task to another coding agent, such as OpenAI Codex, while you keep working, and brings back its answer with the assumptions and open questions it had. Codex is off until you turn it on, because each run sends your code to OpenAI.
